overview:
**Fire danger is rated Low today, driven by cool temps, light winds, and seasonally low ERC (47%) and BI (44%) values.**
- Danger stays Low all week, with ERC/BI readings holding in the 39–51% range through Nov 13.
- Dry, calm weather continues: sunny skies, highs near 45–55°F, light northerly winds, and no measurable precipitation forecast.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- No fire restrictions are active in Montrose, Gunnison, or surrounding BLM/Forest Service jurisdictions in this area; standard year-round rules apply.
- No active wildfires are burning in or near the area's counties (Gunnison, Saguache, San Miguel, Hinsdale, Chaffee, Pitkin, Mesa, Delta, Ouray, Montrose, San Juan, Mineral, Dolores); statewide fire activity remains quiet following recent moisture.
